sv.title: ”The Big Short”-profilen reagerar på Nvidias udda drag
sv.summary: Nvidias presenterade i går siffror för sitt senaste kvartal, men inlämnandet av den fullständiga rapportren dröjer, vilket uppmärksammats av hedgefond-profilen Michael Burry.

en.title: "The Big Short" profile reacts to Nvidia's odd features
en.summary: Nvidia presented figures yesterday for its latest quarter, but submission of the full report is delayed, which has been noted by hedge fund profile Michael Burry.
